name: MARE TRANQUILLITATIS — flat regolith cruise

meta.citation: NASA LRO LOLA + JAXA Kaguya TC merged DEM, 512 ppd (~59 m/px)
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 183 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 59.225 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 69 x 35 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: Deliberately the flattest window found; the scenario is a cruise.

blurb: The flattest window the terrain scan could find, which is the point: with nothing to negotiate, the only difference left is efficiency. WorldVLA still bounces 0.19 m and wanders 0.026 m off line; PragyaSpace bounces 0.032 m, holds 0.001 m, and its step-duration CV is zero to sixteen decimal places.

metrics.signature: efficient long-range traverse on smooth plains
